meta.title: Optimize nancorrmatrix and nancovmatrix for cache locality
meta.body_summary: Refactor nancorrmatrix and nancovmatrix to process observations sequentially for better cache locality; add new benchmark parameters.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit loop reordering PR by maintainer; merged without review or benchmark evidence; narrative only.
